entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.372 of 2019, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Behta Gokul, District Hardoi.
3. This is the second bail application of the present applicant.
The first bail application was rejected for want of prosecution on 18.12.2020.
4. It is argued by counsel for the applicant that the applicant is in custody since 06.12.2019 and the punishment prescribed under Section 304B IPC is seven years.
It is further argued that only P.W.-1 has been examined so far out of the total 16 witnesses proposed to be examined.
Neeru Raidas vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Neeru Raidas vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact that only 1 witness out of the total 16 witnesses has been examined so far,
there is no likelihood of the trial being concluded in the near future, as such, considering the prolonged pre-trial detention of the applicant since 06.12.2019 coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedent, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Neeru Raidas be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 10.4.2024 nishant  Neeru Raidas vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
